rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user before accessing or modifying anything. It performed an order-changing action (switching the jigsaw and issuing a refund) without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing write. It also failed to complete the initial user request to check and potentially correct the address on the account and on all orders—there is no evidence of retrieving or correcting addresses. Additionally, the agent’s claims about the change and refund are unsupported by any visible tool results, and it did not verify the order’s shipping status before making changes. These issues violate the policy and the pass criteria.
